method.cluster_weighting: for the full-panel point, average 60 rotations per target, average targets within each Foldseek cluster, then weight 12 clusters equally
method.nested_sensitivity: within each outer cluster draw, sample one paired saved design replicate and average all 60 rotations; reselect the deployed comparator inside each rotation
method.primary_comparator_selection: full-panel point reselects on full selection data; each bootstrap draw reselects on its sampled cluster selection curves, within every rotation
method.primary_inference: within each draw, sample only the 12 structural clusters, reselect the deployed comparator from sampled selection curves in each rotation, evaluate paired held-out curves, then average all 60 rotations
method.root_rotation_role: repeated cross-fitting over the same roots, not independent population observations

primary.decision_rule: the 12-cluster interval assesses population sampling, while the paired nested sensitivity assesses saved split/design stability; the overall Act IV interpretation is directional only when both analyses agree

question: Does target-adaptive action-step selection improve held-out opportunity over the best panel-wide deployed point?

scope.other_qualities: exploratory; fold identity is an ancillary ten-step refit
